annotation_status: Curated development challenge; source review by one investigator, no independent modern expert adjudication.
attribution: DĀMOS transcriptions: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Label rationales paraphrase Ventris & Chadwick (1956), 1959 reprint; no book scans redistributed.
selection: Small source-supported challenge including counterexamples; maximum two uncomplicated names from each long roster. Not a random or exhaustive corpus sample.
exclusions: Unresolved name/title entries: damaged initial [•~]si-re-u in KN As 1517; ma-ra-te-u in PY An 657; ka-sa-to in PY An 39.
Places, ethnics, deities, children/kinship terms; uncertainty about their semantic identity is not resolved by position.
Damaged target strings and doubtful count-one occurrences in KN Am 821; multiple-quantity names ke-re-no and o-ri-ko in MY Au 102.
Unselected faces and rows remain available for literal repetition only; no further label claims.
